title: 1997 Greer briefing with Admiral Wilson

tellings.quote: 1997 was when the Greer Will Miller uh Thomas Wilson Steven Lovekin meeting took place.

plain: In 1997 in Washington, a meeting is said to have taken place in which Steven Greer, a doctor who campaigns for UFO disclosure, met Admiral Thomas Wilson along with two other men, Willard Miller and Stephen Lovekin, to brief him on what they believed was being hidden about UFOs. A researcher who goes by UAPGerb online mentions the meeting on the show as a known date in the history of secret UFO programmes, without saying where his account comes from.
